title: Fix hardcoded path delimiters and absolute paths for cross-platform compatibility
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
- 3 instances of hardcoded `\` path delimiters in `ChatServices.cs` (L479, L524, L848)
- 1 hardcoded absolute path/URI in `MemorySmith.Bridge/Program.cs` (L16)
- 2 instances of external commands invoked without absolute paths (`VarResolver.cs` L181, `WindowsServiceCommands.cs` L289)

## Impact
Hardcoded Windows path delimiters break cross-platform deployment (Linux containers, Docker). Unqualified external commands allow PATH hijacking.

## Action Required
1. Replace `\` with `Path.DirectorySeparatorChar` or `Path.Combine()` in ChatServices.cs
2. Use `AppContext.BaseDirectory` or configuration-based path resolution in Bridge/Program.cs
3. Replace command names with absolute paths from configuration, or validate/resolve at startup

## Effort
~1h50min

## Priority
P1 — Maintainability/Security
